headline: Australian government property tax weighs heavily on developers; thousands of companies collapse, housing supply in crisis
summary: Growing reliance on property tax revenue by the Australian government is weighing on the construction industry, with thousands of companies reported to have collapsed. Housing supply is described as in crisis.
why: Property taxes and construction activity are linked, so changes in developer costs and project viability affect housing supply and related listed builders and lenders.
